name: Colour
description: #ff6644, #fff on #333, pick: a colour's forms, contrast, and a screen colour picker

help.title: Colours
help.about: A hex, rgb(), hsl() or oklch() colour shows a swatch and its other forms; "formats" picks which (hex, rgb, hsl, oklch, hsv, hwb, lab, lch, oklab, cmyk, vec4, decimal, 0x)

help.title: Contrast
help.about: Two colours on each other: their WCAG contrast ratio, and whether text and large text pass

help.title: Colour picker
help.about: Click any pixel on screen; its hex is copied and the bar opens on it. pick and a space lists what you picked

examples.note: Pick a colour from the screen
What you picked, newest first; Tab shows a colour's forms
